name: Versus title
summary: Two names slide in from opposite sides of a diagonal split with a VS badge between, for battles and comparisons.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; band is 1200 x 360 at s = 1

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: left
params.note: name on the accent side, kept short

params.name: right
params.note: name on the dark side, kept short

params.name: text
params.note: the badge word between the names

params.name: size
params.note: name font size; shrinks to fit

params.name: color
params.note: left side colour; default style accent
